policy: Exact saved bytes. No path normalization or replacement of original judgments.
binary_policy: Every NPZ is unchanged and uses the repository results/**/*.npz LFS rule.
live_snapshot_policy: Active groups include the file census available at capture start. Files are read once. Individual atomic-file versions are retained; this is not a transactional or final snapshot of a live job.
excluded: model weights and fitted lens weights
redundant corrected-followup OLMo cache already embedded in calibration predictions
